title: Mexican Tofu Stir Fry
description: A simple, flavorful Mexican-inspired dish made with crispy tofu and stir-fried vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove tofu from skillet and set aside.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add bell peppers and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Return tofu to skillet and stir in any additional seasonings.
Serve hot, garnished with your favorite toppings.
